mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate falling below 9.0% signals labor market tightening that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE falls below 9.0%, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in real GDP and housing starts indicates robust aggregate demand, accelerating corporate profit growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both GDPC1 and HOUST grow, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% annualized) trigger Fed rate hikes that compress equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of high inflation periods (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%), or regime-conditional Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production signals expanding manufacturing output and economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days through earnings acceleration.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales exceeding 360,000 million signal strong consumer spending that supports revenue growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS exceeds 360,000 million, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent employment growth (PAYEMS) and unemployment decline (UNRATE) indicate accelerating labor market strength, boosting consumer spending and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, rising housing starts (HOUST) signal market overheating that precedes economic slowdowns, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of late-cycle expansion periods when HOUST rises, or regime-conditional Rank IC is below 0.03.
